system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Fire. 1 item slot. Attunement.

Prerequisites: Wilderness: Fauna[1]

A large, cat-sized grasshopper, marked with a fiery pattern down its side. It stares blankly, but likes pets down its side.

Return to Base (Ceremony): During any rest, you can verbally give a single sentence command (up to 8 words) to the grasshopper. It will return to your chieftain via the most direct path, traveling 3 hexes per day, until it provides the message. You may use this once per long rest.

Rulebook p.77.
